{{Quote|The Siege of Trasemene! The Assault on Vardoss IV! The Battle of Galboron! Names that will forever live in the annals of Imperial military history&hellip; and now you can see if you have the brilliance to match those who fought there!|Advertisement for the [[CS-Mark 10]] in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''|<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Vardoss IV''',<ref name="Galladinium" /> also known simply as '''Vardoss''',<ref name="EGTW" /> was a celestial body<ref name="Galladinium" /> located in the [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss system]], a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Vardoss sector/Legends|Vardoss sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Horob system/Legends|Horob system]] as well as the [[Neshei system/Legends|Neshei system]] of the neighboring [[Neshei sector/Legends|Neshei sector]].<ref name="EGTW" />

During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Sixth Negative Regions|Sixth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Vardoss IV. [[19 BBY/Legends|Three years]] later, a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] force [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] [[Ciutric Offensive|intercepted]] at Vardoss IV a [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] force [[Reconquest of the Rim|fleeing]] to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. In a famous confrontation<ref name="EGTW" /> known as the [[Assault on Vardoss IV]],<ref name="Galladinium" /> the Imperials routed their opponent. The celestial body subsequently came to be situated within Imperial borders by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and was also located in the territory of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vardoss IV was first mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vardoss [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Vardoss IV, in grid square J-8,<ref name="TEA" /> while [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' introduced the shortened name "Vardoss."<ref name="EGTW" />
